container.set.int_random_insert.description_en: Cost of one std::set<int>::insert with a unique int element, measured over N insert operations. Elements are inserted in random order.
container.set.int_random_insert.description_zh: std::set<int>::insert 插入唯一 int 元素的单次开销，基于 N 次插入操作测量。元素以随机顺序插入。

container.set.int_random_find_hit.description_en: Cost of one successful std::set<int>::find on a container of size N, measured over N lookups. Elements are looked up in random order.
container.set.int_random_find_hit.description_zh: 大小为 N 的 std::set<int> 上单次成功 find 查询的开销，基于 N 次查找测量。元素以随机顺序查找。

container.set.int_iteration.description_en: Per-element iteration cost for std::set<int>, measured by traversing all N elements.
container.set.int_iteration.description_zh: std::set<int> 的单元素遍历开销，通过遍历全部 N 个元素测量。
